qt: to the Commission Alexander Jungbluth (ESN) Subject:

The planning, certification and signposting of the 16-km ‘Küppeltour’ circuit for walkers walking route were co-financed from the EU’s LEADER development programme. The route passes through several small villages in rural Rhineland-Palatinate. The project seeks to make the region a more attractive destination for tourists1. No publicly documented evidence of any measurable economic impact – such as an increase in overnight stays, job creation or structural investment – has yet been forthcoming. 1.
What precise data on the number of overnight stays in the region before, during and after the project’s implementation was the Commission able to obtain for the purposes of ascertaining its success?
What precise figures are available regarding trends in employment subject to social security contributions and unemployment in the project region before, during and after its implementation?
What oversight arrangements has the Commission established to prevent use of EU for leisure-infrastructure projects that make no clear structural contribution to job creation?
